description: RENPHO makes smart health and wellness technology including smart scales, massage guns, eye massagers and recovery devices. Its partner page says the brand is trusted by 20 million+ customers and runs separate affiliate and creator programs for health-tech creators.

evidence.summary: Official affiliate page: 10% commission, monthly payouts via Impact, plus a Creator Program via Social Snowball. Verbatim cap claims: 'Monthly Payouts, no caps', 'sustainable, long-term revenue with no caps', heading 'Your income, uncapped.', and FAQ 'You earn 10% commission on every sale referred through your unique link or code, with no cap on earnings.'

Creator Program for social creators via Social Snowball: 'Share your RENPHO life on social media, be our spokesperson, and earn unique opportunities, rewards, and more' and 'Unlock unique opportunities and collabs'. FAQ: 'Do I need a minimum follower count? No.'

Scale indicating medium saturation: page states 'backed by a brand trusted by 20 million+ customers' and 'tap into our 20M+ customer base' — an established, widely promoted program, not a small/new one.

name: RENPHO

opportunity.title: RENPHO Creator Program via Social Snowball / Affiliate Program via Impact

reasons.compensation: Published 10% rate plus multiple explicit uncapped statements including an FAQ answer on earnings.
reasons.contact_access: Two clear application routes (Impact and Social Snowball) on one official page; no published partnerships email found.
reasons.credibility: 20M+ customers claimed on official page, established global distribution.
reasons.niche_fit: Smart scales, massage and recovery tech are highly demonstrable in UGC; page targets growing influencers, bloggers and content creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Both programs open for application now, monthly payouts, free marketing materials.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Dedicated Social Snowball creator program, spokesperson and collab opportunities, no follower minimum.

Help Center describes Petterm formulas: Hairball Control Powder for cats, Tear Stain Powder for dogs & cats, and Muscle Gain Soft Chews for dogs.
Petterm Tear Stain Remover product listed on Chewy, showing retail distribution beyond its own site.

name: Petterm

opportunity.title: Petterm Partner Program — 20% commission, no caps

Creator-first terms, verbatim: 'There is no audience size requirement... we don't set hard follower or traffic thresholds', 'You don't need your own website to join. Many of our partners create content solely for TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube', and ambassadors are 'considered for deeper partnerships, including brand campaigns, featured placement, and paid collaborations'. Apply in 5 minutes, approval in 2 days, free Dutch membership for ambassadors who post monthly.

Verbatim FAQ contact: 'Contact us anytime at Affiliates@dutch.com'. Program audience: 'Pet creators, writers, vets, and businesses — you're the ones your community turns to.' No creator-count evidence found, so saturation is unknown.

name: Dutch

reasons.compensation: Published flat $40 per new membership with extra rewards at 10+ referrals, but it is not a percentage rate and no cap statement is published.
reasons.contact_access: Published affiliates email plus a short ambassador application form linked from the official page.
reasons.credibility: Licensed-vet telehealth service with 24/7 care positioning and Impact-run tracking and payments.

description: Fieldy, by Field Labs Inc. (founded 2024, headquartered in Delaware), is a wearable AI note taker worn as a pendant or wristband that transcribes in-person conversations and produces summaries, drafts and follow-ups. Its affiliate program is open to review sites, bloggers, newsletter writers and anyone who recommends products to an audience, paying a notably high 25% base rate.

evidence.summary: Official page: 'Fieldy Affiliate Program: Earn 25% to 50% per Sale', 'You earn 25% of the sale amount on every order, rising to 50% as your monthly sales grow' (25% up to 14 sales/month, 30% at 15-34, 35% at 35-99, 50% at 100+), 30-day credit, paid via Impact. Product Hunt launch post by the founder: 'We are the first wearable note taker to ship to actual users back in March 2024 and have shipped 9000 units to date' — evidence of a small, new brand/program, supporting low creator saturation.

B2B Reviews contact listing: 'Parent Company: Field Labs Inc. Headquarters: Neward, Delaware, Year Founded: 2024', with Instagram instagram.com/fieldyai/, X x.com/fieldyai/, TikTok tiktok.com/@getfieldy, YouTube youtube.com/@FieldyAI.

reasons.opportunity_availability: Public application page live and open.
